title: dog10k pipeline — samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.high_pass_samplesheet and params.low_pass_samplesheet. Each row represents one sequencing run. Samples with multiple runs (lanes) must have multiple rows with the same sample value — they are merged automatically after mapping.

sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces.

run_id.errorMessage: Run ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces (e.g. SRR accession or lane identifier).

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'.

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'.
